notes.title: Cross-Platform Saving
notes.notes: I have finally fixed the issue where Windows save data and Linux save data is separated. I now made them one and the same so you can play your users on either system!

notes.title: GAMMA 1.1.0 Release
notes.notes:
GAMMA 1.1.0 Release

>Replaced and added socials:
|>Bluesky
|>Substack
>Fixed some more number labels appearing as decimals
>Fixed an issue where you could talk to Elyane again after already talking to her
>Made it that you can talk to other characters even after you talk to Elyane
>Fixed roster points being shown incorrectly
>Fixed some typos in lore
>Slightly changed some art
>Added more movement paths to enemies
>Greatly decreased the amount of effects created when killing enemies

notes.title: GAMMA-1.0.31

notes.title: Gamma-1.0.2
notes.notes:
An update with some very important bugfixes:
>WALL health coming up full during battle
>WALL not using healing ICE shard unless if you have Lynda
>Yiwey not giving splicing lore until cycle 62
>Inconsistent XP and Leveling calculations
>Bosses don't have damage numbers

Also includes QoL improvements:
>You now start with one roster point
>Leveling is easier

notes.title: Gamma-1.0.1
notes.notes:
>Found and fixed a problem where buttons just wouldn't respond on Linux.
>This should also now make FIREWALL: Cyber Defense available for Steam Deck

notes.title: GAMMA-1.0.0 is out!
notes.notes:
The sun is shining, the birds are chirping and update GAMMA-1.0.0 is now out, making FIREWALL: Cyber Defense now ready to get ready for release! With a few pains [The programming way] I have added some fun additions to the game, with simply more of the same to just more stuff! The changes include:

>BACE Upgrades! Now another upgrade system!
>BACE Scene now has music!
>Two new ICE Shards: Critical and Sprint!
>Added Androids, the pushy ally!
>Added the Arcane Data currency, for Androids and BACEs!
>Some UI improvements
>Select which BACE you want!
>Finished second BACE Tower conversation!
>Added Playstation Controller glyphs!

Not to mention some previous improvements from the BETA-1.1.0 update:

>Added bodies!
>Bothered by bodies? You can turn them off!
>Added item effects when enemies die. That's a lot of cash.
>Improved enemy leveling: No speed limit but slower speed upgrading and faster health upgrading!
>Added the speed consumable!
>Added XBox Controller glyphs!
>Added tutorial for the HoldToShoot!
>Changed UI a little.
>Added a new way to get lore! Not to mention more lore!
>Fixed some pesty bugs!

And finally, celebrating the completion of the BACE Scene, it is now out on YouTube for all to watch!

[previewyoutube=2TT5167KHj0;full][/previewyoutube]

Well, that's all for now! See ya later folks!

-CyberNinjaX3648
